entities.name: Single-registration mode
entities.description: Mode for interworking between E-UTRAN connected to EPC and 5G systems. Mandatory for UEs supporting both S1 mode and N1 mode.

entities.name: Dual-registration mode
entities.description: Mode for interworking between E-UTRAN connected to EPC and 5G systems. Optional for UEs supporting both S1 mode and N1 mode.

entities.name: EPS attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which interworking mode selection occurs for UEs supporting both S1 mode and N1 mode.

entities.name: Initial registration procedure
entities.description: 5G procedure during which interworking mode selection occurs for UEs supporting both S1 mode and N1 mode.

entities.name: EPS tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which interworking mode selection may occur for UEs supporting both S1 mode and N1 mode.

entities.name: Registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update
entities.description: 5G procedure during which interworking mode selection may occur for UEs supporting both S1 mode and N1 mode.

entities.name: UE supports both S1 mode and N1 mode
entities.description: Precondition for interworking mode selection. UE must support both E-UTRAN/EPC and 5G access.

entities.name: Network supports interworking
entities.description: Precondition for interworking mode selection. Network must support interworking between EPC and 5GCN.

relations.description: EPS attach procedure can establish single-registration mode for interworking
Initial registration procedure can establish single-registration mode for interworking
EPS tracking area updating procedure can establish single-registration mode for interworking
Registration update procedure can establish single-registration mode for interworking
EPS attach procedure requires UE to support both S1 mode and N1 mode for interworking mode selection
Initial registration procedure requires network to support interworking for mode selection
